A few small companion stones beside their host asteroid only. Soft sunlight from UPPER RIGHT; warm ivory highlights and deep cool shadow only ON the rocks and facilities, as in Image1. No floating light aura.
TRANSPARENCY: outside every solid asteroid/building is perfectly clear alpha. Absolutely no painted background color, no black rectangle, stars, nebula, fog, smoke, glowing halos, shadow gradients outside objects, ground plane, checkerboard, platform base, border or vignette. No spacecraft, aircraft, characters, enemies, weapon fire, UI, text, logo or watermark. Beautiful polished hand-painted game background detail, same artist and high-altitude scale as Image1.
